title: Serverware fixed native bootstrap client with scoped egress observation v3
description: Closed independently pinned configuration, at most 16384 bytes: the 18 v1 fields plus required nonnull egress. Installation is forbidden, including null; v1/v2 reject egress, including null. Runtime verifies startup before admitting protected cold egress inputs and before client private-key access/network. A separate signed egress authorization v2 and durable creation claim are required before one never-executed child is created; a separate kernel claim precedes the fixed firewall transaction. Output is observation while owners are held, not workload start, attachment, persistent deployment or CA installation. Schema validation is not permission.

authority.description: Exact independently signed native egress authorization v2 original, at most 32768 bytes, including the separate creation journal. V1 is refused by this public path.

authorityRoot.description: Independently pinned canonical nonweak Ed25519 SPKI PEM original, at most 16384 bytes; actual separate-role exclusions are checked by the native owner.

capabilityToken.description: Protected owner-only single-link regular original containing exact 32..256 URL-safe ASCII token bytes, no LF. Actual hash must equal the dedicated egress capability hash; no token bytes are output or journaled.

launchManifest.description: Protected canonical nativeEgressLaunchManifest/v1 original, at most 4096 bytes without LF. Runtime retains the selected protected executable original, at most 16 MiB. This profile never executes it, supplies arguments/environment, or attaches a network.
